caption: The drawing depicts a wooden crucifix with a human figure affixed to it, centered on a plain light background. The cross is dark brown with visible wood texture, and at the top, there is a tan sign with the inscription "J.N.R.J." in capital letters. The figure on the cross has a light skin tone, brown wavy hair, and a beard. The arms are stretched outward and nailed to the horizontal beam, with visible wounds marked by red coloring on the hands and feet. The figure's head is tilted to the right, and it has a crown of thorns on its head depicted with brown and green colors. Blood is illustrated trickling from wounds on the chest and the right side of the torso. The figure is wearing a loosely draped blue-green loincloth around the waist, and the legs are together, with the feet overlapping and nailed to the vertical beam. There are no other objects or background elements in the image.
title: Crucifix
